The newcomers at the top of the rankings — in share price appreciation, if not yet market value — include drone maker Kratos Defense & Security Solutions Inc., satellite intelligence outfit Planet Labs PBC and data analytics company Palantir Technologies Inc. Each has seen its stock at least double this year.
